question: Intel'in yıllık gelir büyümesinde gerileme var mı? Son üç mali yılın eğilimini, son çeyreklik raporunu ve son şirket açıklamalarını birlikte değerlendir. Yıllık sonuçları ara dönem verileri ve beklentilerden ayır.

expected.review_criteria: Annual revenues and two growth rates, latest 10-Q revenue evidence and 8-K actuals/outlook; distinguish periods and conditional risks.

usage.note: API token estimate, excluding taxes and local hardware costs; missing usage is not zero usage.

answer:
Evet. Intel’in yıllık gelir büyümesi FY2024 (dönem sonu 2024-12-28) için -2.08% iken FY2025’te (dönem sonu 2025-12-27) de negatif kaldı; gelir FY2023’te (dönem sonu 2023-12-30) 54228000000 USD, FY2024’te (dönem sonu 2024-12-28) 53101000000 USD ve FY2025’te (dönem sonu 2025-12-27) 52853000000 USD oldu. Yıllık gelir düşüşü sürdü, ancak büyüme oranındaki düşüş son mali yılda önceki yıla kıyasla daha sınırlıydı. [Source 2] [Source 3]

2026-09-26’da sona eren üçüncü çeyrekte net gelir önceki yılın aynı çeyreğine göre arttı; dokuz aylık net gelir de önceki yılın aynı döneminin üzerindeydi. Bunlar ara dönem sonuçlarıdır, tamamlanmış mali yıl gelirleri değildir. Intel, aynı çeyreğe ilişkin açıklamasında gelir, brüt marj ve hisse başına kârın şirket rehberliğini aştığını bildirdi. [Source 5] [Source 7]

Şirket, yakın vadede PC pazarındaki yavaşlamanın sürmesini beklediğini; buna karşın CPU talebinin güçlü olduğunu ve ek arz sağlamaya odaklandığını belirtti. Ayrıca dördüncü çeyrek için gelir beklentisi açıkladı; bu beklenti gerçekleşmiş bir sonuç değildir ve yıllık büyüme verisi olarak değerlendirilmemelidir. Bu nedenle mevcut kanıtlar, yıllık gelir düşüşü sürerken daha yeni ara dönem sonuçlarının iyileştiğini gösteriyor; ara dönem artışı tek başına yıllık eğilimin tersine döndüğünü kanıtlamaz. [Source 7]

News Release
Intel Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
News Summary
▪Third-quarter revenue was $16.5 billion, up 21% year-over-year (YoY).
▪Third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) attributable to Intel was $0.60; non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel was $0.52.
▪Forecasting fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion; forecasting fourth-quarter EPS attributable to Intel of $0.10 and non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $0.25.
SANTA CLARA, Calif., October 29, 2026 – Intel Corporation today reported third-quarter 2026 financial results.
“Our Q3 results demonstrate improving execution, meaningful progress expanding supply and continued advancement of our process technology,” said Lip-Bu Tan, Intel CEO. “Despite near-term headwinds across the PC industry, demand for our CPUs remains robust, reinforcing our confidence in the long-term growth opportunities for our business. Our immediate priority is to unlock additional supply to meet extraordinary demand for our Xeon family, while strengthening our product portfolio and roadmap. We are moving with urgency and focus to capitalize on these opportunities to deliver sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value.”
“We delivered another solid quarter. Revenue, gross margin and earnings per share exceeded guidance, including our strongest data center revenue growth in 15 years,” said David Zinsner, Intel CFO. “Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year, but we remain optimistic about the opportunities across our broader portfolio, and we will continue making disciplined investments in capacity and working capital to increase supply and support future growth.”

News Release
Intel Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
News Summary
▪Third-quarter revenue was $16.5 billion, up 21% year-over-year (YoY).
▪Third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) attributable to Intel was $0.60; non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel was $0.52.
▪Forecasting fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion; forecasting fourth-quarter EPS attributable to Intel of $0.10 and non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $0.25.
SANTA CLARA, Calif., October 29, 2026 – Intel Corporation today reported third-quarter 2026 financial results.
“Our Q3 results demonstrate improving execution, meaningful progress expanding supply and continued advancement of our process technology,” said Lip-Bu Tan, Intel CEO. “Despite near-term headwinds across the PC industry, demand for our CPUs remains robust, reinforcing our confidence in the long-term growth opportunities for our business. Our immediate priority is to unlock additional supply to meet extraordinary demand for our Xeon family, while strengthening our product portfolio and roadmap. We are moving with urgency and focus to capitalize on these opportunities to deliver sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value.”
“We delivered another solid quarter. Revenue, gross margin and earnings per share exceeded guidance, including our strongest data center revenue growth in 15 years,” said David Zinsner, Intel CFO. “Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year, but we remain optimistic about the opportunities across our broader portfolio, and we will continue making disciplined investments in capacity and working capital to increase supply and support future growth.”

•Announced a collaboration with SAP to bridge business IT systems and the operational technology that controls physical equipment and processes through Physical AI.
Foundry Momentum
